name: thaddius
_comment: WORKFLOW: `.rjson on` to arm, then walk your raid UP the ramps and past both platforms (the bots FOLLOW you up — that's the only reliable way up; they can't path the long low->high climb on their own). Then `.rjson pull`: each bot that you've led within range of an add breaks off and engages it — MAIN TANK on Stalagg, OFF-TANK on Feugen, everyone else on the nearest add. The instant combat starts the PROVEN C++ actions take over (ThaddiusAttackNearestPetAction for on-platform positioning + Magnetic Pull swaps; ThaddiusMoveToPlatformAction for the z312->z304 transition jump). Polarity is Level-2; add death-sync is the generic target_hp_ahead + @damage suppress.

rules._comment: PULL (on `.rjson pull`): MAIN TANK engages Stalagg once you've led it within 25y (so it follows you up the ramp first, then breaks off). Proximity gate also re-hands-off on Magnetic Pull: yanked to Feugen, it drops out of range here and the C++ nearest-pet rule retargets it.
PULL: OFF-TANK engages Feugen once led within 25y.

PULL: NON-TANKS (dps/healers) engage the nearest add once you've led them within 30y of either one. Two rules so it fires near either platform. The in-combat C++ then positions them to the ranged anchors.
ADD PHASE (Level-1, combat-gated). Splits by nearest add + holds tanks/ranged at their on-platform anchors; handles Magnetic Pull tank swaps.
ADD PHASE re-aggro: taunt when a tank loses its add (Magnetic Pull).
TRANSITION (Level-1): both adds dead -> jump down from the add platforms (z312) to the low platform (z304). Pure C++ JumpTo geometry.

THADDIUS PHASE -- polarity grouping (Level-2). Negative charge -> LEFT spots, Positive -> RIGHT, melee vs ranged offset. 1:1 port of ThaddiusMovePolarityAction's 6 anchors. self_aura gate means these only fire once Polarity Shift has marked the bot. stack_point yields once parked, so generic combat DPSes the boss.

suppress._comment: ADD PHASE: no formation-follow / generic target-assist while the C++ pet action owns positioning + targeting. Combat-gated, so it does NOT suppress follow before/while approaching the pull (bots need follow to ride you up the ramp). Mirrors ThaddiusGenericMultiplier's pet-phase clamp.
THADDIUS PHASE: stop formation/master-follow from fighting the polarity stack. dps/tank assist NOT suppressed, so bots DPS the boss between polarity moves.

DEATH-SYNC throttle: zero a bot's non-healing damage casts while its current add is <=40% HP and the other add is >=3% higher, so the two adds finish within the ~5s revive window. Self-deactivates once the adds are dead. Data form of ThaddiusGenericMultiplier's <=40%/>=3% clamp.
